Refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund already requested or issued has not appeared in the account; refund waiting time.
activate_my_card: How to activate a new card, or a problem completing card activation.
age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account, or accounts for children.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using or setting up Apple Pay or Google Pay, including top-ups through these wallets.
atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines support the card and where cash can be withdrawn.
automatic_top_up: Setting up, changing, or understanding automatic recurring account top-ups.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: An incoming bank-transfer top-up or deposit has not appeared in the account balance.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cash or cheque deposit has not appeared in the balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Transfer blocked because the beneficiary, recipient or destination is not allowed.
cancel_transfer: Cancel, stop, recall, or reverse a money transfer already initiated.
card_about_to_expire: An expiring or expired card and its replacement or renewal.
card_acceptance: Where or at which merchants, countries, shops or online services the card can be used to pay.
card_arrival: An already ordered card has not arrived, is delayed, or needs delivery tracking.
card_delivery_estimate: Expected or expedited card delivery times, delivery scheduling, or how long a card normally takes to arrive.
card_linking: Linking, relinking, or connecting a physical card to the account or app.
card_not_working: A physical card generally fails or does not work, without a more specific named payment, contactless, activation or PIN issue.
card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or surcharge for making a card purchase/payment, rather than its exchange rate or a duplicate charge.
card_payment_not_recognised: An unfamiliar card payment, merchant or transaction on the statement that the customer does not recognise.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: An incorrect or unexpected currency exchange rate applied to a card purchase.
card_swallowed: An ATM retained or swallowed the physical card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees or charges for an ATM cash withdrawal.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal in the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
compromised_card: Suspected stolen card details, a hacked or compromised card, fraudulent use, or protecting/freezing a card because someone else is using it.
contactless_not_working: Contactless/tap-to-pay payments fail or the contactless feature does not work.
country_support: Which countries or residents are supported for opening or using the banking service/account.
declined_card_payment: A card purchase or payment was explicitly declined or rejected.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM withdrawal was declined or rejected, or the ATM refuses to dispense cash.
declined_transfer: A bank transfer explicitly marked declined or rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unfamiliar or unauthorised direct-debit payment.
disposable_card_limits: Restrictions, limits or how many disposable virtual cards can be used or created.
edit_personal_details: Changing personal account information such as name, address, email or phone number.
exchange_charge: Fees or charges for currency exchange itself, not a purchase or cash withdrawal.
exchange_rate: How currency exchange rates are determined or what exchange rate applies generally.
exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert currencies within the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: An extra small verification charge such as one pound, euro or dollar on a statement.
failed_transfer: A money transfer failed, cannot be completed, or has a technical error, rather than explicitly declined, pending or forbidden beneficiary.
fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held, supported or used in the account.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Obtaining, creating or understanding a disposable/single-use virtual card.
get_physical_card: Finding, receiving, viewing or retrieving the card PIN. Despite this category's name, its training examples concern obtaining the PIN.
getting_spare_card: Obtaining an extra, second, backup or spare physical card.
getting_virtual_card: Obtaining or creating a regular virtual card, rather than a disposable one.
lost_or_stolen_card: A physical card is lost or stolen; what to do, block it or replace it.
lost_or_stolen_phone: A phone is lost or stolen; protecting or recovering account access.
order_physical_card: Ordering, requesting or paying for a physical card.
passcode_forgotten: Forgotten app password/passcode or login credentials; recovering access, not the card PIN.
pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending or uncompleted; how long pending status lasts.
pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still marked pending.
pending_top_up: A top-up is marked pending or still processing.
pending_transfer: A transfer is marked pending or stuck processing.
pin_blocked: Card PIN blocked or locked after too many wrong PIN attempts; unblocking it.
receiving_money: Receiving a salary, wages or payments from another person into the account.
request_refund: How to request a refund, return a purchase or obtain money back from a merchant.
reverted_card_payment?: A card purchase/payment was reverted or reversed and the money returned.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which external card types or currencies are accepted for topping up, such as American Express.
terminate_account: Closing, deleting or terminating the banking account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Charges for topping up the account using a bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up using a payment card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Whether or how to top up the account with cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: A card/account top-up failed or was unsuccessful, rather than pending or reverted.
top_up_limits: Maximum/minimum top-up amounts or frequency limits.
top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed/reverted and its money returned or removed.
topping_up_by_card: How to add funds using a card, or using the wrong card to top up.
transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or card payment charged twice or duplicated.
transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for sending a money transfer.
transfer_into_account: How to make an incoming bank transfer or find bank details to fund this account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: An outgoing transfer has not reached its recipient/beneficiary.
transfer_timing: General arrival/processing times for a bank transfer, without an explicit pending status.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification fails or cannot be completed, including rejected documents.
verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are required, or verification status/process.
verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or documenting where funds/income came from.
verify_top_up: Verifying or authenticating a top-up or its payment card.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card does not work.
visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or choosing between those brands.
why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is necessary or requested.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed the wrong or only partial cash amount.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong currency exchange rate for an ATM cash withdrawal.
